notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a nonlegendary creature whose base toughness is 2 or less.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature whose base toughness is 2 or less.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to the creature token.
The creature token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
